text: Historical reland651621c87d6d73bdbf85c6c4ac20f34d0acec225 requests thunderbird/ews-rs revision ad3c9077987cbf28e9c60a868e5a258e20d4ba70 in the manifest, both locked EWS packages, and the source replacement mapped to vendored-sources. This aligns the source identity fields that differed in the original landing. Compare against the reland parent: only the two EWS source fields change in Cargo.lock; broader version differences from the first landing were already present. This is an additive reland-phase correction to the earlier pin-mismatch lesson. It does not recommend this historical revision today or prove Cargo/build success.
title: The multi-Reply-To reland aligns the EWS manifest, lockfile and source replacement
